name: Anti-dumping duties: large residential washers from China
notes: Preliminary determination 81 FR 48741; cash deposits from publication. Final order 82 FR 9371 (6 Feb 2017). The case behind the 2016-17 move of washer production from China to Thailand and Vietnam.

name: Section 201 safeguard: large residential washers
notes: Proclamation 9694. Canada excluded; WTO developing countries below 3% of imports also excluded, too small to move shares by 5 points.

name: Section 232 steel (first wave)
notes: Proclamations 9705 and 9711. Canada, Mexico, the EU, Australia, Argentina, Brazil and South Korea were exempt at first; Korea, Argentina, Brazil later took quotas and Australia stayed exempt.

name: Section 232 aluminium (first wave)
notes: Proclamations 9704 and 9710. Korea and Brazil were briefly exempt until 1 May 2018; that short exemption is ignored here.

name: Section 232 steel extended to EU/Canada/Mexico
notes: Proclamation 9759. Duties on Canada and Mexico were lifted on 20 May 2019, inside the 12-month after window.

name: Section 232 aluminium extended to EU/Canada/Mexico
notes: Proclamation 9758. Duties on Canada and Mexico were lifted on 20 May 2019, inside the 12-month after window.
